categories.main_business_segments: Chongqing Mas Science & Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the IoT and safety sectors, focusing on integrated technology and equipment for mining safety, environmental protection, and urban management. The company offers comprehensive solutions and services in IoT+ safety and emergency, mining, city management, and environmental protection. Its main products include intelligent mining systems, environmental monitoring and sewage treatment equipment, and smart city management platforms.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies such as intelligent sensing, IoT, big data analytics, AI video analysis, 5G and F5G high-speed network transmission, intelligent gas extraction, intelligent ventilation, and precise personnel and equipment positioning. It has developed proprietary platforms including sensor development, substation development, power supply platforms, an industrial internet operating system, and a mining safety large model. Production follows a 'stock + order' manufacturing model with mature in-house production lines for sensors, power supplies, communication devices, and mining wastewater treatment equipment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are primarily large state-owned enterprises and coal mining groups in China, including national energy groups and regional mining companies. The company serves the coal mining and non-coal mining industries, environmental protection sectors, and urban management authorities. Its products and solutions are widely used in mining safety monitoring, environmental monitoring, sewage treatment, and smart city infrastructure.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with significant sales in regions such as Jin-Meng, Shanxi-Gansu-Ningxia, Anhui-Shandong-Jiangsu, Hunan-Hubei-Jiangxi, Xinjiang, Hebei-Henan, Yunnan-Guizhou, Sichuan-Chongqing, and Guangxi-Guangdong. It has established a nationwide marketing network covering these key mining and urban regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chongqing Mas operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the development, production, and sales of intelligent mining safety equipment, environmental monitoring devices, and smart city management systems. It also provides integrated solutions and after-sales operation and maintenance services, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider and service operator.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in AI, 5G, big data, cloud computing, and digital twin technologies, integrating these with traditional mining and environmental technologies. Key R&D projects include the SPG mining safety large model, unified central station system upgrades, AI video recognition safety monitoring, and smart mining big data control platforms. It pursues open R&D collaborations with research institutes and enterprises to maintain technological leadership and commercial value.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of mining safety monitoring systems, environmental protection equipment, and smart city management platforms. The company also earns income from maintenance and data services, with a sales model dominated by direct sales supplemented by distribution channels. Revenue recognition follows contract completion and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a competitive position in the intelligent mining safety and environmental monitoring industry in China, with established market share and brand influence. It competes with other specialized IoT and safety technology providers in the mining and environmental sectors. Its comprehensive product portfolio, proprietary technology platforms, and strategic partnerships with large state-owned enterprises strengthen its industry standing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 500.6 million, a 16.05% increase from 2023, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 55.59 million, up 24.5%. Total assets stood at about RMB 1.35 billion with a slight increase from the previous year. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory supported by increased sales in core mining products and expanding market demand.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chongqing Mas differentiates itself through its integrated IoT-based intelligent mining safety solutions, combining hardware and software platforms with AI-driven analytics and 5G connectivity. Its SPG mining safety large model and unified control platforms provide advanced multi-modal data fusion and intelligent risk management capabilities. The company emphasizes product ease of use, maintenance, and rapid deployment, supported by a strong technical service team and comprehensive after-sales support, delivering enhanced safety, efficiency, and digital transformation for mining and environmental customers.
